title: Shimon, R' Tarfon’s maternal uncle
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Sifrei, Beha'alotekha 37, as sounding the trumpets in the Temple while lame in one leg.[^1][^2]

notes.text: לז is 37, not the earlier unsupported 77 suggestion. Sifrei Beha’alotekha 37 remains Hyman’s unverified historical locator without a modern section substitution.

אחי אמו is maternal uncle, not brother or father. מריע בחצוצרות means sounding trumpet blasts; ביהמ״ק is contextually the Temple. His being lame in one leg remains explicit. Shimon is untitled; Tarfon’s abbreviated title remains R'.
